keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's row begins in 1305 but the infobox says 'Founded: c. 1301'; the page gives no extent beyond 'roughly corresponding to the present-day Isparta Province'. The 1305 shape (57,555 km2, about 200 cells including the Antalya country and Burdur) stands in for 1301-1304, approximate. The page has no km2 figure, so no ratio; the shape is several times the Isparta Province the page names, because it still holds the Teke country before 1321.

Years only: unchanged shape, 57,555 km2, valid 1305-1320. The Beylik of Teke page: the Teke beylik 'was established by a branch of the Hamidid dynasty in 1321' after 'a split of territories between two brothers', so the shape loses the Antalya country in 1321, not in 1326 as Cliopatria draws it.

Years only: unchanged shape, 30,933 km2 (111 cells: the Isparta, Burdur and Afyon country less the 91 cells that became Teke), valid 1321-1332. Cliopatria starts it in 1326; the Teke page dates the split to 1321.

The germiyanids dossier takes the 42 cells in 1333 and the rest in 1344 on Cliopatria's say-so alone (confidence 1 there); the page does not mention Germiyan. No km2 on the page.

The 1333 corrected shape is carried to 1391; the page dates only the sale of Akşehir and Beyşehir to Murad I (no year), which this shape does not include.

notes:
Row identity: Cliopatria's 'Beylik of Hamid' (Wikipedia 'Hamidids', Q2410637) is one state; its row covers 1305-1343, the page 1301-1391. Two new facts override Cliopatria: the Teke split is 1321 (Beylik of Teke page; Cliopatria 1326) and the beylik survives to 1391 (Hamidids page; Cliopatria hands everything to Germiyan by 1344).
Conflict with the germiyanids dossier (me-09-f): it records gains from beylik-of-hamid in 1333 (42 cells round Eğirdir and Isparta) and 1344 (the last 69 cells), both Cliopatria only at confidence 1 and the Germiyanids page silent on Hamid. This dossier follows the Hamidids page and keeps Isparta Province Hamidid to 1391 (corrected keyframes 1333 and 1344), so the two dossiers draw the same cells; the orchestrator or a gap-filler should decide, ideally with the Germiyanids and Hamidids pages side by side. The state also has no 1344-1391 Cliopatria shape, so the corrected shape rests on one sentence ('roughly corresponding to the present-day Isparta Province') and on the ruler table.
Page budget (1-2 pages): Hamidids, Beylik of Teke, plus the Anatolian beyliks table for the capital (a third page, used for one line). No km2 on any page, so no infobox ratio.
Not settled: the capital in the Hamidids infobox (not stated; Eğirdir from the beyliks table), the dates of the sale of Akşehir and Beyşehir to Murad I (the sentence has no year, Murad I reigned 1362-1389 on another page not opened), the overlordship (Ilkhanate vassal_start 1305 and vassal_end 1335 for beylik-of-hamid sit in the ilkhanate dossier), the Ottoman dossier's lack of a 1391 gain for the Sanjak of Hamid, and the ruler gaps (1324-1327; Mustafa and Ilyas undated).
Cross-dossier: beylik-of-teke has found 1321 with counterpart beylik-of-hamid (mirrored here as a split); ottoman-empire has no 1391 gain from beylik-of-hamid and no counterpart for Eğirdir; byzantine-empire neighbours in Cliopatria's 1305-1313 seed are not discussed on the Hamidids page.
